CustomField.description: Tax amount calculated by the SAP-side determination path (SapTaxCalculationService — ADR-024). Coexists with the native commercetax.TaxEngineAdapter chain that runs on Invoice generation; this field is the SAP-parallel reading for production-readiness verification. Populated as a side-effect of SapTaxCalculationService.calculateForInvoice; null until the service is run.
CustomField.label: SAP Tax Amount
